items.exampleEn: The scientist left a legacy of important discoveries.
items.exampleZh: 這位科學家留給後世許多重要的發現。

items.exampleEn: Her parents made many sacrifices so she could study abroad.
items.exampleZh: 她的父母做了許多犧牲，讓她能出國讀書。

items.exampleEn: The priest preaches in the small church every Sunday.
items.exampleZh: 那位神父每個星期日都在小教堂講道。

items.exampleEn: Many religions teach people about salvation.
items.exampleZh: 許多宗教都會教導人們關於救贖的道理。

items.exampleEn: The preacher spoke to a large crowd in the square.
items.exampleZh: 那位傳道人在廣場上對一大群人講話。

items.exampleEn: Only privileged members can use the private garden on the roof.
items.exampleZh: 只有享有特權的會員，才能使用屋頂的私人花園。
items.glossZh: 享有特權的；優渥的；榮幸的

items.exampleEn: Ancient prophets were often seen as messengers of the gods.
items.exampleZh: 古代的先知常被視為眾神的使者。

items.exampleEn: He used his inheritance to buy a small farm.
items.exampleZh: 他用繼承來的遺產買了一座小農場。

items.exampleEn: He made his customary visit to the market on Sunday morning.
items.exampleZh: 星期日早上，他照例去了一趟市場。

items.sentenceEn: She shared her inheritance with her two brothers.
items.sentenceZh: 她把遺產和兩個兄弟平分了。

items.audioEn: I feel privileged to have studied with such a great teacher.
items.audioZh: 能跟這麼好的老師學習，我覺得很榮幸。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼覺得很榮幸？

items.sentenceEn: Some monks preach in the village once a month.
items.sentenceZh: 有些僧侶每個月會到村裡講道一次。

items.sentenceEn: Bowing is the customary greeting in Japan.
items.sentenceZh: 在日本，鞠躬是慣常的打招呼方式。

items.stemEn: The band's greatest ____ is a song that every child still sings.
items.stemZh: 這個樂團留給後世最大的貢獻，是一首至今每個孩子都會唱的歌。

items.stemEn: Parents often ____ their own free time for their children.
items.stemZh: 父母常常為了孩子犧牲自己的空閒時間。

items.passageEn: In the small town of Marlow, a statue honors Thomas Kirwan, a preacher who arrived in 1850. Although he was born into a privileged family, he gave away most of his inheritance to build a school and a clinic. Some people called him a prophet because he warned that the river would flood, and it did. For many poor families, his school was a kind of salvation. Today, it is still customary for students to leave flowers at the statue on his birthday. His greatest legacy is the town itself.
items.passageZh: 在 Marlow 這個小鎮上，有一座雕像紀念 Thomas Kirwan，他是一位在 1850 年來到這裡的傳道人。雖然他出身優渥的家庭，卻把大部分的遺產捐了出來，蓋了一所學校和一間診所。有些人稱他為先知，因為他曾警告河水會氾濫，後來真的發生了。對許多貧窮的家庭來說，他的學校就像一種救贖。直到今天，學生們仍習慣在他生日那天到雕像前獻花。他留給後世最大的影響，就是這個小鎮本身。

questions.questionZh: Kirwan 怎麼使用他繼承的遺產？
options: 捐出來蓋了一所學校和一間診所

questions.questionZh: 為什麼有人稱他為先知？
options: 他能說好幾種不同的語言
他每天都在廣場上大聲講道

items.promptZh: 在台灣，過年時給紅包是一種習俗。
referenceEn: In Taiwan, it is customary to give red envelopes at Chinese New Year.
Giving red envelopes at Chinese New Year is customary in Taiwan.
rubricZh: customary 表示「習慣上的、依慣例的」，用法例如 it is customary to…、… is customary 等
「紅包」可寫，例如 red envelopes、red packets 等
「過年」可寫，例如 Chinese New Year、the Lunar New Year 等

items.promptZh: 這位網球選手犧牲了所有假期，每天都在球場上練習。
referenceEn: The tennis player sacrificed every holiday to practice on the court every day.
The tennis player made a big sacrifice, spending every holiday training on the court.
rubricZh: 「犧牲」可用動詞或名詞 sacrifice（例如 sacrificed every holiday、made a sacrifice 等）
時態配合內容（例如 sacrificed、has sacrificed 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正："her two brothers" 譯為「兩個哥哥」，多加了「年長」資訊（原文未說兄或弟）；建議「兩個兄弟」（§11-20）。
執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似：prophet 例句把先知寫成替人算未來的人（visited the prophet to ask about their future），對宗教中的先知角色較像算命師，宗教敏感度上可能不夠中性；建議改用中性事實句（例如 the words of an ancient prophet）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依裁示改成中性事實句 Ancient prophets were often seen as messengers of the gods.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 B：privileged 卡與閱讀都是「出身優渥家庭」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 卡改 Only privileged members can use the private garden on the roof.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 B：聽選用到「榮幸的」義但釋義沒列
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 釋義改「享有特權的；優渥的；榮幸的」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 B 疑似 2：mcq 與閱讀都是「為窮人蓋學校是最大的 legacy」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 題幹改 The band's greatest ____ is a song that every child still sings.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長裁示：一般單字組成的地名、人名（Elm Hill、Reed）比照人名規則換掉；中文欄保留英文名
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: Elm Hill 改 Marlow、Thomas Reed 改 Thomas Kirwan，中譯與題目保留英文名

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：「常用 it is customary to…」沒有「例如…等」（§11-23），建議改「例如 it is customary to…、… is customary 等」，參考答案第 2 句即為另一結構。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示評分要點統一改「例如…等」：customary 表示「習慣上的、依慣例的」，用法例如 it is customary to…、… is customary 等／「紅包」可寫，例如 red envelopes、red packets 等／「過年」可寫，例如 Chinese New Year、the Lunar New Year 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：customary 表示「習慣上的、依慣例的」，用法例如 it is customary to…、… is customary 等／「紅包」可寫，例如 red envelopes、red packets 等／「過年」可寫，例如 Chinese New Year、the Lunar New Year 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（sacrifice）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u22-l01-q18；目標字沿用 sacrifice
